schema.name: meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (   key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   value TEXT,   updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

schema.name: odds_current
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE odds_current (   race_id TEXT NOT NULL,   horse_no INTEGER NOT NULL,   win_odds REAL,   popularity INTEGER,   body_weight INTEGER,   body_weight_change INTEGER,   horse_status TEXT DEFAULT '',   updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,   PRIMARY KEY (race_id, horse_no) )

schema.name: odds_history
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE odds_history (   id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,   race_id TEXT NOT NULL,   horse_no INTEGER NOT NULL,   win_odds REAL,   popularity INTEGER,   captured_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

schema.name: race_details
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE race_details (   race_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   race_date TEXT NOT NULL,   payload TEXT NOT NULL,   analysis_ready INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

schema.name: race_summaries
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE race_summaries (   race_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   race_date TEXT NOT NULL,   circuit TEXT NOT NULL,   track TEXT NOT NULL,   race_no INTEGER NOT NULL,   start_time TEXT,   title TEXT,   surface TEXT,   distance INTEGER,   weather TEXT,   condition TEXT,   volatility_label TEXT,   volatility_score INTEGER,   race_status TEXT DEFAULT '',   updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

schema.name: idx_odds_history_race
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_odds_history_race ON odds_history(race_id, horse_no, captured_at)

schema.name: idx_race_summaries_date
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_race_summaries_date ON race_summaries(race_date, circuit, track, race_no)
